headline: JPMorgan Lifts S&P 500 Target to 8,000: How High Can It Go by Year-End?
summary: The S&P 500 is about 1% from Wall Street's average year-end target after its best week since April. JPMorgan just raised its own forecast to 8,000.

headline: QUICK SPARK: Microsoft Price Target Raised — 'Not Building Too Fast' Given Demand
summary: Bernstein sticks with Microsoft, raises price target to $660. Firm praises measured approach to capacity buildout as AI capex surges.

headline: Microsoft Stock Rises 2%: Upcoming Maia 300 Chip Launch Targets Reduced Nvidia Reliance
summary: Microsoft stock gained nearly 2% following reports of its upcoming Maia 300 AI chip unveil and discussions with TSMC for 300,000+ units.
